name: godot-pixel-studio
description: A pixel-art game studio for Godot 4: role-based skills for design, art direction, sprite drawing, GDScript, scenes, and QA, plus a deterministic pixel drawing tool.

interface.longDescription: Run a small studio inside Codex for Godot 4 2D pixel-art games. Role skills cover game design, art direction, sprite drawing, GDScript, scene assembly, and QA. All pixel art is produced deterministically by the bundled drawing tool, so sprites stay on-palette, grid-aligned, and diff-able.
defaultPrompt: Start a Godot 4 pixel-art game and set up the studio workflow
